zizhitongjian:083:s0195: 王衍自表離婚，許之，妃慟哭而歸。

Direct parallel to Jinshu 053:s0073: Wang Yan himself petitions to dissolve his daughter's crown-prince marriage after the deposition. The quoted divorce request is the same distinctive action and family relationship.
zizhitongjian:083:s0218: 太子至許，遺王妃書，自陳誣枉，妃父衍不敢以聞。

The source explicitly says consort's father Yan (妃父衍), receiving the crown prince's letter, did not dare report it. In the same chapter, 083:s0129-s0130 names Wang Yan as father of the crown prince's younger-daughter bride, and 083:s0195 names his divorce request, matching Jinshu 053:s0035-s0036,s0073. The consort/father/deposed-prince sequence supplies the bridge.
